svg.title: Product-First Affiliate Traffic Architecture
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-product-first-affiliate-traffic-team; chapter number: 11; title: Product-First Affiliate Traffic Architecture; subtitle: Owning a product, a tool or an audience instead of renting vanity traffic; chart type: org_architecture; center: role: Product-first affiliate owner; headcount: Not reported by practitioners; focus: Own the product, tool or audience; SEO is where player value is highest; spokes: role: Technical SEO and link lead; type: Organic search; kpi: Content confirmed visible to Google before any link is bought; about 7% of links lost per year recovered via Majestic and Giga Indexer; role: AI search lead; type: Generative engine visibility; kpi: Bing Webmaster Tools live and cited listicles reverse-engineered; at least two of domain, article and anchor relevance; role: Owned audience lead; type: App, email and Telegram capture; kpi: 20%+ conversion into banner click, subscription or add-to-bet-slip versus well under 1%; role: Paid acquisition lead; type: PPC and paid social; kpi: Optimized to FTDs not sign-ups, bots filtered, no fast scaling while CPC climbs 40 to 80% at peaks; caption: Content-only SEO is over; winners pair search with owned audiences and FTD-optimized paid traffic, with revshare players worth $500 to $2,000 each on 25 to 50% deals.; assumptions note: Role split is a synthesis of separate practitioner workflows; no team headcount was reported, and black-hat tactics remain disputed between practitioners.; note: Attributed to Big Pond Digital (0_KHkuMmtVQ, jWqa6ck6G3Y), Revpanda Group (OlzqNLFabLI, Xyf6JUN9RFg), Odys Podcast (ESj1bVRdO2s) and Powerhouse Affiliate (pihR_hy7xRU).
